description: This file contains composable UI components related to chat message displays in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It defines the visual appearance of chat bubbles for different roles (user, assistant, system), including message content handling, loading indicators, and code blocks.

classes.name: ChatBubbleStyle
classes.description: Data class representing styling options for chat bubbles, including alignment, background color, and border color.

methods.name: ChatMessageBubble
methods.description: Main composable function that displays a chat message bubble with appropriate styling based on the message role.

methods.name: ChatBubbleContainer
methods.description: Reusable container composable that wraps chat bubble content with background, border, and role label.

methods.name: ChatMessageBody
methods.description: Displays the message content, including text and images, within a chat bubble.

methods.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
methods.description: Displays a typing indicator bubble with animated dots and 'Thinking...' text.

methods.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
methods.description: Displays a bubble indicating ongoing tool execution, showing a list of tools being used.

methods.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
methods.description: Displays a streaming message from the assistant with a special style.

methods.name: bubbleStyle
methods.description: Returns styling information for a chat bubble based on the role (user, system, assistant).

methods.name: roleLabel
methods.description: Maps a role string to a display label.

methods.name: ChatBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image decoded from a base64 string, or an error message if decoding fails.

methods.name: DotPulse
methods.description: Displays animated pulsing dots as a loading indicator.

methods.name: PulseDot
methods.description: Composable representing a single pulsing dot.

methods.name: ChatCodeBlock
methods.description: Displays a code block in a styled surface, optionally with a language label.
